preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string S for each test case must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'WIN' or 'LOSE' for each test case.
If there is at least one '1' in S, the output must be 'WIN'; otherwise, it must be 'LOSE'.
